title: The zero current of ℝ^P is a minimizing cycle with an integer multiplicity representation of zero weight (parent step 2)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there exist a current C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n on Euclid P) and an integer multiplicity representation R_C of C in ℝ^P (an IMRep univ n with R_C.Represents C) such that C is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), ∂C = 0 in ℝ^P (BoundaryVanishes C), and the weight of R_C is the zero measure (R_C.measure = 0). One may take C = 0 and R_C = (∅, 1, 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RC : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C ∧ RC.Represents C ∧ RC.measure = 0
